title: Remove Duplicate Legends From the Shareable Scoring Overview
body:
The initial 24-cell SG forest chart repeated Draw/Fade legend entries for each club, placing six entries over the center panel title.

## Acceptance Criteria

Use one two-entry Draw/Fade legend with readable spacing in both delivery-mode plots. Add a failing regression test before fixing the shared rendering code and regenerate the V2 overview PNGs without changing data.

## Validation

TDD rendering regression and visual inspection of 1920 × 1080 outputs.

## Handoff

Branch `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`; source `src/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/overview.py`. Keep open until merged implementing PR.
